name: inline-style
description: Inline style props (`style={{ ... }}`). Every inline style is a token-system bypass; the agent should migrate to className with a token utility, or to a design-token CSS variable. Three.js / canvas / globe components are usually exempt — pass an allow-list via .anvil/archaeology/queries/inline-style.json overlay.

filter.reason: Inline style bypasses the token system — replace with a className or CSS variable.
